rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Walk-away test (M2+)
50% magic rule (M3-M8)
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is M2 per the maintainer Arc block; rule scoped to M3-M8.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust the agentic design - no human backstops
Quality ladder
One exercise = one bounded activity
rules_evaluated.evidence: Five phases form one internal do (P1-P3 push-back) -> observe/adjust (P4 second-pass walk-down) -> observe (P5 compare) arc; never sub-numbered as separate exercises.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Modules composable across variants
rules_evaluated.evidence: No VARIANT markers; single-training (AE101) exercise content.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Three-level completeness
rules_evaluated.evidence: Strategy frame in maintainer block; runtime artifact = plan file trainer/second agent reads; sendable asset = sharpened plan + a CLAUDE.local.md rule that produces downstream input.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Pattern-recognition LOs need n>=2 instances with contrast
rules_evaluated.evidence: Two distinct reads (own push-back at P3, second-pass walk-down at P4) explicitly paired and compared at P5 for what each catches vs the other.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Progression-with-variations is the spine
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer Arc notes this picks up M1's compound loop and runs it at deeper plan scope - same move, new face, per rule's own worked example.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student agency - adults decide
rules_evaluated.evidence: Multiple explicit agency beats: 'When you have two push-backs forming in your head, move on. Don't wait for the clock,' 'Stop when the second read starts reaching... The agent doesn't always know when to stop; you do.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Delegation - student brings, Claude screens
rules_evaluated.evidence: L17: 'ask Claude to surface three candidates from recent issues, PRs, or TODO comments' - issues/PRs access (GitHub API/gh CLI) isn't named as an available connector, unlike TODO comments which are plain repo grep.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Either name the connector this assumes (e.g. gh CLI) or narrow the fallback to repo-local surfaces (TODO comments, recent commits) that need no external access.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Split mega-exercise when phases = distinct skills + distinct artifacts
rules_evaluated.evidence: Phases chain on one artifact (the same plan file) and one continuous session; no natural pause with a distinct artifact boundary that would warrant a split.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Artifact-realism check
rules_evaluated.evidence: L17: same issues/PRs fallback as rule 11 - accessibility of 'recent issues, PRs' as a live source for Claude isn't verified/named in prework or this file.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Confirm gh CLI or equivalent is a fair default for AE101's engineer audience, or drop issues/PRs from the fallback list.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Teach principle + technique - default
Auto-fire sim+eval after significant rewrite
rules_evaluated.evidence: Quality block cites compendium-audited 2026-08-02 with per-class SHAs; the prior pedagogy REVISE from the same judges run is being re-fired by this very judge invocation, which is the auto-fire loop working as designed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go; live in prompts not body
rules_evaluated.evidence: Mandatory teaching prompts (push-back-1, walk-down-2, name-pattern-3) are fenced; body callouts are pacing suggestions ('typical session 5 to 12', 'or so' register) or optional escalations, not bare imperative counts.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Corporate infra = nice-to-have, never forcing function
Personal-first, team promotion via human conversation
rules_evaluated.evidence: Compound step writes to personal CLAUDE.local.md by default; team-worthy patterns explicitly flagged for a separate PR, not auto-promoted.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Measure silent failure, not just friction
rules_evaluated.evidence: Cohort-evaluation practice (post-hoc), not a static file-architecture property. The maintainer's own Decision points (P4 <15min = task too small) show awareness in spirit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't pre-set categories before experiment runs
rules_evaluated.evidence: Experiment/evaluation-design meta-rule, not applicable to a shipped exercise file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verification layers sample DIFFERENT error distributions
Cheap-before-expensive verification ordering
Rule in memory without forcing function = worse than no rule
rules_evaluated.evidence: Memory-system enforcement meta-rule, not a property of this exercise file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Short skeptical pushback on 'done' = re-verify trigger
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer-process meta-rule, not a property of this exercise file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cohort execution is trainer-paced + concurrent, not sequential
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body explicitly reframes agent-wait time as reading time ('While Claude works, take in the side material... Wait isn't dead time'), matching the trainer-paced-plus-concurrent model.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Host-skill optional; maintainer blocks trainer-only
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer block header reads 'Push-back moves' naming the trainer as actor throughout; no host-skill/Nerd dependency in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats: in-chat over file-write
rules_evaluated.evidence: P5's compare-the-two-reads beat happens in chat; the only persistent write is the plan file (already a live artifact the second agent reads) and the Compound-step CLAUDE.local.md rule (downstream reader = future sessions/PR).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Classroom = default delivery; body teaches work, trainer manages room
rules_evaluated.evidence: No authored group/pair/room-share sentences; body sentences are all about the work (plan, push-back, walk-down artifact).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Eval = fixed yardstick; thing measured learns
rules_evaluated.evidence: Eval-process meta-rule, not applicable to a shipped exercise file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reading burden for verification = banned. Claude audits Claude
rules_evaluated.evidence: Verification is agent-vs-agent (second-pass walk-down reads the plan, not the student manually diffing Claude's output for correctness).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Self-report + self-audit charity - verify at artifact
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'Catch the re-softening in the revised plan' section explicitly instructs reading the revised plan itself rather than trusting Claude's acknowledgment - artifact-level verification against self-report charity.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Offered structures need forced-engagement mechanic
rules_evaluated.evidence: The offered plan is not rubber-stampable by design: P3 forces two specific push-backs before approval is even reachable (approval prompt itself declined via 'No, keep planning').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Source-type blindness on ingestion
rules_evaluated.evidence: No heterogeneous source-folder ingestion in this exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Task selection drives outcome - name floor AND ceiling
rules_evaluated.evidence: Floor and ceiling both named: 'A one-line fix is too small for plan mode; a refactor whose outcome you can't hold in your head is too big,' plus bolded anti-pattern callout 'Just a simple task that spans a few files. Not an epic.'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Maintainer-block hedge naming section's own failure mode = cut-signal
rules_evaluated.evidence: No self-undermining hedge in the Watch-fors; each names a diagnostic and fix with cited evidence, not a hedge questioning its own premise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audience tier determines authoring substrate
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 engineer-tier framing throughout (plan mode, Claude Code mechanics, CLAUDE.local.md), consistent with the plugin/CLAUDE.md-layer substrate for this audience.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verification machinery needs smoke-test before trust
rules_evaluated.evidence: No new hook/judge/loop machinery introduced by this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Context-loading tiers as staged progression
rules_evaluated.evidence: No auto-load/lazy-load/explicit-load tier-reveal beat in this exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Removals are strategic - ask before cutting
rules_evaluated.evidence: Generation-process rule, not a checkable property of the shipped file. Maintainer notes show good-faith compliance on prior cuts/keeps with rationale.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Symmetric visible-mechanics > runtime fork when dual-runtime constraints break agentic move
rules_evaluated.evidence: No dual-runtime fork present in this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Load-bearing platform feature = no fallback. Gate or redesign
rules_evaluated.evidence: Plan mode is gated as a hard prerequisite of the exercise (Phase 2 enters it directly); no diluting 'if unavailable, do Y instead' fallback offered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Eval architecture - partition by evidence source, not criterion count
rules_evaluated.evidence: Meta-rule about the eval system's own judge partitioning, not a property of this exercise file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Plug points + UX
rules_evaluated.evidence: Plug points named specifically (student's own repo, own backlog task, sponsor-stated rules home), each structurally invited downstream. 'Three questions at a time' framing in body matches the fenced walk-down prompt's own batching - no mismatch for a fast operator reading prompt-to-prompt.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-exercise leap test - 3 observable Monday outcomes
rules_evaluated.evidence: Leap test names three observable verbs: picks plan mode before approving, sends two specific push-backs naming step numbers, runs a second-pass walk-down on plans touching more than two files.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-phase failure mode + escape hatch
rules_evaluated.evidence: Maintainer Watch-fors and Push-back moves name a dominant failure mode (rubber-stamp, performative push-back, softening-on-regeneration, timer abuse, senior refusal, P4 drift, P5 deflection) each paired with a named recovery move.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heavy fan-out prompts get body recovery callout
rules_evaluated.evidence: P4's walk-down (agent-driven branch enumeration) gets a body recovery callout ('If it feels sluggish, ask why... relax the requirement'); this is a single-agent question loop rather than N>2 parallel fan-out, so the heavier over-reading/premature-stop dual-direction callout isn't required here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Save belongs with authoring, not loading
rules_evaluated.evidence: No create-then-use pair with a save/install split across exercises in this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Convenience-driven prompts with known shape-bias - body acknowledgment callout
Deliberate-antipattern prompts = class-judge exempt, flagged-by-design
rules_evaluated.evidence: No prompt in this file is deliberately engineered as a before/after cross-module behavioral-risk contrast.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session widget - shape; place by learning flow
rules_evaluated.evidence: No **Session** widget in this file; exercise continues the module's already-open session.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Widgets carry semantics, not just emphasis
Pre-action framing doesn't preview prompt's payoff
rules_evaluated.evidence: Opening 'What you build' line now reads 'Your own two push-backs, in your voice. A second-pass walk-down... catches the branches you can't see.' The prior REVISE flagged this line for also stating 'catch what a human catches' before P5's discovery beat; that clause has been removed from the opener (maintainer note: '§53 partial accept, maintainer call' - the human-catches half now stays unstated until the Evaluate beat at P5, per maintainer instruction not to re-flag the surviving clause).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Engineer-audience audit fixes default to body callout, not forcing function
Multi-session (any new mechanic mid-arc) ships as packaging, not new primitive
rules_evaluated.evidence: No new mid-arc mechanic (worktrees, parallel sessions) introduced; single continuous session throughout, explicitly kept open into the Compound step.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: /clear = tool, not ceremony
rules_evaluated.evidence: /clear not invoked in this file; session is deliberately kept open for the Compound step.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inbound links preserve pedagogical beat across reference restructuring
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reference-page restructuring event touches this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Scan at the unit the rule names, not convenient larger one
rules_evaluated.evidence: Auditor-scan-discipline meta-rule, not a property of the file itself.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verify mechanism before proposing surgery
rules_evaluated.evidence: Generation-process meta-rule about proposing SKILL.md/framework changes, not a property of this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Acting on a flagged item - verify before fixing; its prescribed fix is a hypothesis
rules_evaluated.evidence: Fix-verification meta-rule about acting on audit findings, not a property of this file - though this judge run itself applied this discipline: re-verified the prior §53 and §64 findings against current file state before re-scoring rather than trusting the punchlist as still-open.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Callouts next to prompts: steer, don't pre-empt
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'If it feels sluggish, ask why' (P4) and 'Too many low-level questions? Steer up' both teach generalizable steering moves (notice -> ask -> loosen) rather than naming one rot-prone failure mode.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Persistent TODO surfaces stale by default - audit before acting
rules_evaluated.evidence: Auditor-discipline meta-rule about long-lived punchlists, not a property of this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Maintainer blocks point, don't restate. Link architecture doc where they touch delivery

Grep confirms 'push-back-on-the-plan-4' and 'Prompt register' no longer appear anywhere in this file - the stale note has been removed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cross-module prerequisite rescue: run it late, never fabricate
